name: Zhou Mingrui
role: Original identity and consciousness before becoming Klein Moretti.

name: Klein Moretti
role: Primary real-world identity in Tingen and the emotional/familial anchor of the story.

name: The Fool
role: Mysterious existence above the gray fog and presiding identity of the Tarot Club.

name: Sherlock Moriarty
role: Backlund private detective identity used for investigations and contact with the local Beyonder world.
sourceNote: Klein introduces himself as Sherlock Moriarty to Mrs. Sammer in Chapter 215.

name: The World
role: A Tarot Club persona controlled by Klein, allowing him to trade, commission and act as a separate member under The Fool.

name: Gehrman Sparrow
role: Cold, dangerous adventurer and bounty hunter identity designed for the sea and pirate world.
sourceNote: Chapter 483 is New Identity; Klein's prepared documents name him Gehrman Sparrow.

name: Dwayne Dantès
role: Mature tycoon persona used to enter Backlund high society, Church circles and investment networks.
sourceNote: Chapter 733 shows Klein's identification documents bearing the name Dwayne Dantès.

name: Merlin Hermes
role: Wandering Miracle Magician identity used to fulfill wishes and act as a Miracle Invoker in the real world.
sourceNote: The wandering-magician phase begins in this section; Klein later explicitly gives the name Merlin Hermes.
